ar: الفرقان
en: Sura 25: Al-Furqan

p.src: 25:1  Blessed is the One Who has sent down the Criterion to His slave, so that he may be a warner to the worlds[1],

ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى نَزَّلَ ٱلْفُرْقَانَ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦ لِيَكُونَ لِلْعَـٰلَمِينَ نَذِيرًا
en: Blessed is the One Who has sent down the Criterion to His slave, so that he may be a warner to the worlds[1],
u.src: 25:1  Blessed is the One Who has sent down the Criterion to His slave, so that he may be a warner to the worlds[1],

en: [1] i.e., both men and jinn.

p.src: 25:2  He to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and earth, Who has never begotten a son, and has no partner in His dominion. He has created everything and measured it precisely.

ar: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ شَرِيكٌ فِى ٱلْمُلْكِ وَخَلَقَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ تَقْدِيرًا
en: He to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and earth, Who has never begotten a son, and has no partner in His dominion. He has created everything and measured it precisely.
u.src: 25:2  He to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and earth, Who has never begotten a son, and has no partner in His dominion. He has created everything and measured it precisely.

p.src: 25:3  They have taken besides Him other gods who can create nothing but are themselves created. Nor do they have the power to harm or benefit themselves, nor do they have the power to cause death, give life or resurrect the dead.

ar: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً لَّا يَخْلُقُونَ شَيْـًٔا وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ وَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ لِأَنفُسِهِمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا نَفْعًا وَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ مَوْتًا وَلَا حَيَوٰةً وَلَا نُشُورًا
en: They have taken besides Him other gods who can create nothing but are themselves created. Nor do they have the power to harm or benefit themselves, nor do they have the power to cause death, give life or resurrect the dead.
u.src: 25:3  They have taken besides Him other gods who can create nothing but are themselves created. Nor do they have the power to harm or benefit themselves, nor do they have the power to cause death, give life or resurrect the dead.

p.src: 25:4  Those who disbelieve say, “This [Qur’an] is nothing but a lie which he has fabricated, with the help of other people.” What they claim is totally unjust and false.

ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّآ إِفْكٌ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ وَأَعَانَهُۥ عَلَيْهِ قَوْمٌ ءَاخَرُونَ ۖ فَقَدْ جَآءُو ظُلْمًا وَزُورًا
en: Those who disbelieve say, “This [Qur’an] is nothing but a lie which he has fabricated, with the help of other people.” What they claim is totally unjust and false.
u.src: 25:4  Those who disbelieve say, “This [Qur’an] is nothing but a lie which he has fabricated, with the help of other people.” What they claim is totally unjust and false.

p.src: 25:5  And they say, “Ancient fables which he has written down; they are dictated to him morning and evening.”

ar: وَقَالُوٓا۟ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ ٱكْتَتَبَهَا فَهِىَ تُمْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
en: And they say, “Ancient fables which he has written down; they are dictated to him morning and evening.”
u.src: 25:5  And they say, “Ancient fables which he has written down; they are dictated to him morning and evening.”

p.src: 25:6  Say, “It has been sent down by the One Who knows the secrets of the heavens and earth. He is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.”

ar: قُلْ أَنزَلَهُ ٱلَّذِى يَعْلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
en: Say, “It has been sent down by the One Who knows the secrets of the heavens and earth. He is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.”
u.src: 25:6  Say, “It has been sent down by the One Who knows the secrets of the heavens and earth. He is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.”

p.src: 25:7  And they say, “What kind of messenger is this who eats food and walks in the markets?[2] If only an angel had been sent down to him to be a warner with him,

ar: وَقَالُوا۟ مَالِ هَـٰذَا ٱلرَّسُولِ يَأْكُلُ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشِى فِى ٱلْأَسْوَاقِ ۙ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مَلَكٌ فَيَكُونَ مَعَهُۥ نَذِيرًا
en: And they say, “What kind of messenger is this who eats food and walks in the markets?[2] If only an angel had been sent down to him to be a warner with him,
u.src: 25:7  And they say, “What kind of messenger is this who eats food and walks in the markets?[2] If only an angel had been sent down to him to be a warner with him,

en: [2] i.e., He is just a human being like us.

p.src: 25:8  or a treasure had been cast down to him, or he had a garden to eat from it.” The wrongdoers say, “You are following none but a bewitched man.”

ar: أَوْ يُلْقَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِ كَنزٌ أَوْ تَكُونُ لَهُۥ جَنَّةٌ يَأْكُلُ مِنْهَا ۚ وَقَالَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ إِن تَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا رَجُلًا مَّسْحُورًا
en: or a treasure had been cast down to him, or he had a garden to eat from it.” The wrongdoers say, “You are following none but a bewitched man.”
u.src: 25:8  or a treasure had been cast down to him, or he had a garden to eat from it.” The wrongdoers say, “You are following none but a bewitched man.”

p.src: 25:9  See how they call you names[3]. Thus they have gone astray and cannot find a way.

ar: ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ ضَرَبُوا۟ لَكَ ٱلْأَمْثَـٰلَ فَضَلُّوا۟ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَبِيلًا
en: See how they call you names[3]. Thus they have gone astray and cannot find a way.
u.src: 25:9  See how they call you names[3]. Thus they have gone astray and cannot find a way.

en: [3] Such as a magician, a poet, a liar, a madman, and a bewitched.

p.src: 25:10  Blessed is He Who, if He wills, could give you better than that: gardens under which rivers flow, and could give you palaces.

ar: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِىٓ إِن شَآءَ جَعَلَ لَكَ خَيْرًا مِّن ذَٰلِكَ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ وَيَجْعَل لَّكَ قُصُورًۢا
en: Blessed is He Who, if He wills, could give you better than that: gardens under which rivers flow, and could give you palaces.
u.src: 25:10  Blessed is He Who, if He wills, could give you better than that: gardens under which rivers flow, and could give you palaces.

p.src: 25:11  But they deny the Hour, and We have prepared for those who deny the Hour[4] a Blazing Fire.

ar: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلسَّاعَةِ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِمَن كَذَّبَ بِٱلسَّاعَةِ سَعِيرًا
en: But they deny the Hour, and We have prepared for those who deny the Hour[4] a Blazing Fire.
u.src: 25:11  But they deny the Hour, and We have prepared for those who deny the Hour[4] a Blazing Fire.

en: [4] i.e., the Resurrection Day.

p.src: 25:12  When it sees them from a far distance, they will hear its raging and roaring.

ar: إِذَا رَأَتْهُم مِّن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍ سَمِعُوا۟ لَهَا تَغَيُّظًا وَزَفِيرًا
en: When it sees them from a far distance, they will hear its raging and roaring.
u.src: 25:12  When it sees them from a far distance, they will hear its raging and roaring.

p.src: 25:13  And when they are thrown into a narrow space therein, chained together, they will cry out for death.

ar: وَإِذَآ أُلْقُوا۟ مِنْهَا مَكَانًا ضَيِّقًا مُّقَرَّنِينَ دَعَوْا۟ هُنَالِكَ ثُبُورًا
en: And when they are thrown into a narrow space therein, chained together, they will cry out for death.
u.src: 25:13  And when they are thrown into a narrow space therein, chained together, they will cry out for death.

p.src: 25:14  Do not cry out this Day for death only once, but cry out many times.”

ar: لَّا تَدْعُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ثُبُورًا وَٰحِدًا وَٱدْعُوا۟ ثُبُورًا كَثِيرًا
en: Do not cry out this Day for death only once, but cry out many times.”
u.src: 25:14  Do not cry out this Day for death only once, but cry out many times.”

p.src: 25:15  Say, “Is that better or the Eternal Paradise which has been promised to the righteous?” It will be as a reward for them and as a final destination.

ar: قُلْ أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ أَمْ جَنَّةُ ٱلْخُلْدِ ٱلَّتِى وُعِدَ ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ ۚ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَزَآءً وَمَصِيرًا
en: Say, “Is that better or the Eternal Paradise which has been promised to the righteous?” It will be as a reward for them and as a final destination.
u.src: 25:15  Say, “Is that better or the Eternal Paradise which has been promised to the righteous?” It will be as a reward for them and as a final destination.

p.src: 25:16  They will have there whatever they wish for, abiding therein forever. That is a promise that your Lord has taken upon Himself.”

ar: لَّهُمْ فِيهَا مَا يَشَآءُونَ خَـٰلِدِينَ ۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ وَعْدًا مَّسْـُٔولًا
en: They will have there whatever they wish for, abiding therein forever. That is a promise that your Lord has taken upon Himself.”
u.src: 25:16  They will have there whatever they wish for, abiding therein forever. That is a promise that your Lord has taken upon Himself.”

p.src: 25:17  On the Day when He will gather them along with those whom they worshiped besides Allah[5], He will say, “Did you mislead these slaves of Mine, or did they stray from the right way on their own?”

ar: وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَيَقُولُ ءَأَنتُمْ أَضْلَلْتُمْ عِبَادِى هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ أَمْ هُمْ ضَلُّوا۟ ٱلسَّبِيلَ
en: On the Day when He will gather them along with those whom they worshiped besides Allah[5], He will say, “Did you mislead these slaves of Mine, or did they stray from the right way on their own?”
u.src: 25:17  On the Day when He will gather them along with those whom they worshiped besides Allah[5], He will say, “Did you mislead these slaves of Mine, or did they stray from the right way on their own?”

en: [5] i.e., Jesus, angels, pious men, saints, etc.

p.src: 25:18  They will say, “Glory be to You! It was not for us to take besides You any guardians. But You provided for them and their forefathers pleasures, until they forgot the message, for they were a ruined people.”

ar: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ مَا كَانَ يَنۢبَغِى لَنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ مِن دُونِكَ مِنْ أَوْلِيَآءَ وَلَـٰكِن مَّتَّعْتَهُمْ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ نَسُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۢا بُورًا
en: They will say, “Glory be to You! It was not for us to take besides You any guardians. But You provided for them and their forefathers pleasures, until they forgot the message, for they were a ruined people.”
u.src: 25:18  They will say, “Glory be to You! It was not for us to take besides You any guardians. But You provided for them and their forefathers pleasures, until they forgot the message, for they were a ruined people.”

p.src: 25:19  Thus they will deny all what you say[6], so you cannot avert [punishment] nor can you get any help. Whoever among you does wrong[7], We will make him taste a great punishment.

ar: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوكُم بِمَا تَقُولُونَ فَمَا تَسْتَطِيعُونَ صَرْفًا وَلَا نَصْرًا ۚ وَمَن يَظْلِم مِّنكُمْ نُذِقْهُ عَذَابًا كَبِيرًا
en: Thus they will deny all what you say[6], so you cannot avert [punishment] nor can you get any help. Whoever among you does wrong[7], We will make him taste a great punishment.
u.src: 25:19  Thus they will deny all what you say[6], so you cannot avert [punishment] nor can you get any help. Whoever among you does wrong[7], We will make him taste a great punishment.

en:
[6] i.e., False gods will deny their worshipers on the Day of Judgment.
 [7] i.e., associate partners with Allah.

p.src: 25:20  We did not send any messengers before you [O Prophet] except that they ate food and walked in the markets. We have made some of you as a trial for others. Will you have patience? For your Lord is All-Seeing.

ar: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ إِلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ لَيَأْكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشُونَ فِى ٱلْأَسْوَاقِ ۗ وَجَعَلْنَا بَعْضَكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ فِتْنَةً أَتَصْبِرُونَ ۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ بَصِيرًا
en: We did not send any messengers before you [O Prophet] except that they ate food and walked in the markets. We have made some of you as a trial for others. Will you have patience? For your Lord is All-Seeing.
u.src: 25:20  We did not send any messengers before you [O Prophet] except that they ate food and walked in the markets. We have made some of you as a trial for others. Will you have patience? For your Lord is All-Seeing.

p.src: 25:21  Those who do not expect to meet Us say, “Why are angels not sent down to us or why do we not see our Lord?” They have been too proud of themselves, and have transgressed immensely.

ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَآءَنَا لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْنَا ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ أَوْ نَرَىٰ رَبَّنَا ۗ لَقَدِ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَعَتَوْ عُتُوًّا كَبِيرًا
en: Those who do not expect to meet Us say, “Why are angels not sent down to us or why do we not see our Lord?” They have been too proud of themselves, and have transgressed immensely.
u.src: 25:21  Those who do not expect to meet Us say, “Why are angels not sent down to us or why do we not see our Lord?” They have been too proud of themselves, and have transgressed immensely.

p.src: 25:22  On the Day when they see the angels[8], there will be no glad tidings for the wicked, and [the angels] will say, “Absolutely forbidden for you[9].”

ar: يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ لَا بُشْرَىٰ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُجْرِمِينَ وَيَقُولُونَ حِجْرًا مَّحْجُورًا
en: On the Day when they see the angels[8], there will be no glad tidings for the wicked, and [the angels] will say, “Absolutely forbidden for you[9].”
u.src: 25:22  On the Day when they see the angels[8], there will be no glad tidings for the wicked, and [the angels] will say, “Absolutely forbidden for you[9].”

en: [8] i.e., upon death, after death, upon resurrection, etc. [9] Referring to all good things.

p.src: 25:23  We will turn to whatever deeds they did and turn them into scattered dust[10].

ar: وَقَدِمْنَآ إِلَىٰ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ مِنْ عَمَلٍ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ هَبَآءً مَّنثُورًا
en: We will turn to whatever deeds they did and turn them into scattered dust[10].
u.src: 25:23  We will turn to whatever deeds they did and turn them into scattered dust[10].

en: [10] Good deeds of the disbelievers will be of no avail to them on Judgment Day, such as charity, due to their disbelief and denial of the afterlife.

p.src: 25:24  On that Day the people of Paradise will have the best abode and the finest resting place.

ar: أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَيْرٌ مُّسْتَقَرًّا وَأَحْسَنُ مَقِيلًا
en: On that Day the people of Paradise will have the best abode and the finest resting place.
u.src: 25:24  On that Day the people of Paradise will have the best abode and the finest resting place.

p.src: 25:25  On the Day when the sky will split asunder with clouds, and the angels will be sent down in succession.

ar: وَيَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِٱلْغَمَـٰمِ وَنُزِّلَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ تَنزِيلًا
en: On the Day when the sky will split asunder with clouds, and the angels will be sent down in succession.
u.src: 25:25  On the Day when the sky will split asunder with clouds, and the angels will be sent down in succession.

p.src: 25:26  The true dominion on that Day belongs to the Most Compassionate[11], and it will be a hard day for the disbelievers.

ar: ٱلْمُلْكُ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْحَقُّ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۚ وَكَانَ يَوْمًا عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ عَسِيرًا
en: The true dominion on that Day belongs to the Most Compassionate[11], and it will be a hard day for the disbelievers.
u.src: 25:26  The true dominion on that Day belongs to the Most Compassionate[11], and it will be a hard day for the disbelievers.

en: [11] On Judgment Day the whole authority will be for Allah alone; whereas, in this world, Allah gave some authority to kings, rulers, etc.

p.src: 25:27  On that Day, the wrongdoer will bite his hands saying, “Would that I had taken a way with the Messenger[12]!

ar: وَيَوْمَ يَعَضُّ ٱلظَّالِمُ عَلَىٰ يَدَيْهِ يَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى ٱتَّخَذْتُ مَعَ ٱلرَّسُولِ سَبِيلًا
en: On that Day, the wrongdoer will bite his hands saying, “Would that I had taken a way with the Messenger[12]!
u.src: 25:27  On that Day, the wrongdoer will bite his hands saying, “Would that I had taken a way with the Messenger[12]!

en: [12] i.e., followed the Prophet (ﷺ).

p.src: 25:28  Woe to me! Would that I had not taken so-and-so[13] as a close friend!

ar: يَـٰوَيْلَتَىٰ لَيْتَنِى لَمْ أَتَّخِذْ فُلَانًا خَلِيلًا
en: Woe to me! Would that I had not taken so-and-so[13] as a close friend!
u.src: 25:28  Woe to me! Would that I had not taken so-and-so[13] as a close friend!

en: [13] i.e., the one who misguided him.

p.src: 25:29  He led me astray from the Reminder[14] after it had come to me.” Satan always betrays man[15].

ar: لَّقَدْ أَضَلَّنِى عَنِ ٱلذِّكْرِ بَعْدَ إِذْ جَآءَنِى ۗ وَكَانَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ خَذُولًا
en: He led me astray from the Reminder[14] after it had come to me.” Satan always betrays man[15].
u.src: 25:29  He led me astray from the Reminder[14] after it had come to me.” Satan always betrays man[15].

en: [14] i.e., the Qur’an or Allah’s remembrance. [15] Forsakes him after leading him into evil.

p.src: 25:30  The Messenger said, “O my Lord, my people have taken this Qur’an as a thing to be abandoned[16].”

ar: وَقَالَ ٱلرَّسُولُ يَـٰرَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِى ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ مَهْجُورًا
en: The Messenger said, “O my Lord, my people have taken this Qur’an as a thing to be abandoned[16].”
u.src: 25:30  The Messenger said, “O my Lord, my people have taken this Qur’an as a thing to be abandoned[16].”

en: [16] i.e., not reading it; not listening to it; not understanding it; not living by it; not conveying it to others; preferring something else to it, etc.

p.src: 25:31  Thus did we assign for every prophet an enemy from among the wicked, but your Lord is sufficient as a Guide and Helper.

ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِىٍّ عَدُوًّا مِّنَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ هَادِيًا وَنَصِيرًا
en: Thus did we assign for every prophet an enemy from among the wicked, but your Lord is sufficient as a Guide and Helper.
u.src: 25:31  Thus did we assign for every prophet an enemy from among the wicked, but your Lord is sufficient as a Guide and Helper.

p.src: 25:32  Those who disbelieve say, “Why was the Qur’an not sent down to him all at once?” [We sent it] in this way so that We may strengthen your heart thereby, and We have revealed it in a gradual manner.

ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ جُمْلَةً وَٰحِدَةً ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهِۦ فُؤَادَكَ ۖ وَرَتَّلْنَـٰهُ تَرْتِيلًا
en: Those who disbelieve say, “Why was the Qur’an not sent down to him all at once?” [We sent it] in this way so that We may strengthen your heart thereby, and We have revealed it in a gradual manner.
u.src: 25:32  Those who disbelieve say, “Why was the Qur’an not sent down to him all at once?” [We sent it] in this way so that We may strengthen your heart thereby, and We have revealed it in a gradual manner.

p.src: 25:33  Whenever they bring you an argument, We bring you the truth and the best explanation.

ar: وَلَا يَأْتُونَكَ بِمَثَلٍ إِلَّا جِئْنَـٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَحْسَنَ تَفْسِيرًا
en: Whenever they bring you an argument, We bring you the truth and the best explanation.
u.src: 25:33  Whenever they bring you an argument, We bring you the truth and the best explanation.

p.src: 25:34  Those who will be dragged on their faces to Hell – they will be in the worst position and farthest astray from the right path.

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُحْشَرُونَ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَأَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
en: Those who will be dragged on their faces to Hell – they will be in the worst position and farthest astray from the right path.
u.src: 25:34  Those who will be dragged on their faces to Hell – they will be in the worst position and farthest astray from the right path.

p.src: 25:35  We gave Moses the Scripture and appointed along with him his brother Aaron as a helper.

ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهُۥٓ أَخَاهُ هَـٰرُونَ وَزِيرًا
en: We gave Moses the Scripture and appointed along with him his brother Aaron as a helper.
u.src: 25:35  We gave Moses the Scripture and appointed along with him his brother Aaron as a helper.

p.src: 25:36  We said, “Go, both of you, to the people who have rejected Our signs[17].” Then We destroyed them utterly.

ar: فَقُلْنَا ٱذْهَبَآ إِلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَدَمَّرْنَـٰهُمْ تَدْمِيرًا
en: We said, “Go, both of you, to the people who have rejected Our signs[17].” Then We destroyed them utterly.
u.src: 25:36  We said, “Go, both of you, to the people who have rejected Our signs[17].” Then We destroyed them utterly.

en: [17] i.e., the divine teachings reached them through Prophet Jacob and Joseph, and the righteous people of Israel.

p.src: 25:37  Also the people of Noah, when they rejected the messengers[18], We drowned them and made them an example for mankind. And We have prepared for the wrongdoers a painful punishment.

ar: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ لَّمَّا كَذَّبُوا۟ ٱلرُّسُلَ أَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ لِلنَّاسِ ءَايَةً ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
en: Also the people of Noah, when they rejected the messengers[18], We drowned them and made them an example for mankind. And We have prepared for the wrongdoers a painful punishment.
u.src: 25:37  Also the people of Noah, when they rejected the messengers[18], We drowned them and made them an example for mankind. And We have prepared for the wrongdoers a painful punishment.

en: [18] Denial of Noah was equal to denying all of Allah’s messengers.

p.src: 25:38  Also [We destroyed] ‘Ād and Thamūd, and the people of the Well[19], and many generations between them.

ar: وَعَادًا وَثَمُودَا۟ وَأَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلرَّسِّ وَقُرُونًۢا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ كَثِيرًا
en: Also [We destroyed] ‘Ād and Thamūd, and the people of the Well[19], and many generations between them.
u.src: 25:38  Also [We destroyed] ‘Ād and Thamūd, and the people of the Well[19], and many generations between them.

en: [19] i.e., people of prophet Shuʿayb, or those mentioned in Surah Yā Sīn (36:13-29), or a tribe of Thamūd, etc. Rass (lit., well); for they killed their prophet by throwing him into or hanging him down an old or dry well. (Well)

p.src: 25:39  To each We gave examples [of the previous nations], and each We destroyed completely.

ar: وَكُلًّا ضَرَبْنَا لَهُ ٱلْأَمْثَـٰلَ ۖ وَكُلًّا تَبَّرْنَا تَتْبِيرًا
en: To each We gave examples [of the previous nations], and each We destroyed completely.
u.src: 25:39  To each We gave examples [of the previous nations], and each We destroyed completely.

p.src: 25:40  They have surely passed by the town[20] that was destroyed by a terrible rain [of stones]. Have they not seen it? But they do not expect to be resurrected[21].

ar: وَلَقَدْ أَتَوْا۟ عَلَى ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِىٓ أُمْطِرَتْ مَطَرَ ٱلسَّوْءِ ۚ أَفَلَمْ يَكُونُوا۟ يَرَوْنَهَا ۚ بَلْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ نُشُورًا
en: They have surely passed by the town[20] that was destroyed by a terrible rain [of stones]. Have they not seen it? But they do not expect to be resurrected[21].
u.src: 25:40  They have surely passed by the town[20] that was destroyed by a terrible rain [of stones]. Have they not seen it? But they do not expect to be resurrected[21].

en:
[20] i.e., the city of Sodom; the people of Prophet Lot.
 [21] So they do not take lessons from the doom of the past nations.

p.src: 25:41  When they see you [O Prophet], they only ridicule you, “Is this the one whom Allah has sent as a messenger?

ar: وَإِذَا رَأَوْكَ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى بَعَثَ ٱللَّهُ رَسُولًا
en: When they see you [O Prophet], they only ridicule you, “Is this the one whom Allah has sent as a messenger?
u.src: 25:41  When they see you [O Prophet], they only ridicule you, “Is this the one whom Allah has sent as a messenger?

p.src: 25:42  He would have almost led us astray from our gods if we had not been so devoted to them.” But when they see the punishment, they will come to know who is further astray from the right way.

ar: إِن كَادَ لَيُضِلُّنَا عَنْ ءَالِهَتِنَا لَوْلَآ أَن صَبَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا ۚ وَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ حِينَ يَرَوْنَ ٱلْعَذَابَ مَنْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
en: He would have almost led us astray from our gods if we had not been so devoted to them.” But when they see the punishment, they will come to know who is further astray from the right way.
u.src: 25:42  He would have almost led us astray from our gods if we had not been so devoted to them.” But when they see the punishment, they will come to know who is further astray from the right way.

p.src: 25:43  Have you [O Prophet] seen the one who takes his desire as his god, will you then be a keeper over him?

ar: أَرَءَيْتَ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَـٰهَهُۥ هَوَىٰهُ أَفَأَنتَ تَكُونُ عَلَيْهِ وَكِيلًا
en: Have you [O Prophet] seen the one who takes his desire as his god, will you then be a keeper over him?
u.src: 25:43  Have you [O Prophet] seen the one who takes his desire as his god, will you then be a keeper over him?

p.src: 25:44  Do you think that most of them hear or understand?[22] They are just like cattle[23], rather they are further astray from the right way.

ar: أَمْ تَحْسَبُ أَنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ يَسْمَعُونَ أَوْ يَعْقِلُونَ ۚ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا كَٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ ۖ بَلْ هُمْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
en: Do you think that most of them hear or understand?[22] They are just like cattle[23], rather they are further astray from the right way.
u.src: 25:44  Do you think that most of them hear or understand?[22] They are just like cattle[23], rather they are further astray from the right way.

en:
[22] They follow others blindly.
 [23] i.e., like livestock or sheep, that follow without asking wherever they are led.

p.src: 25:45  Do you not see how your Lord extends the shade? If He had willed, He could have made it still. Then We made the sun an indication of it[24].

ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَيْفَ مَدَّ ٱلظِّلَّ وَلَوْ شَآءَ لَجَعَلَهُۥ سَاكِنًا ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا ٱلشَّمْسَ عَلَيْهِ دَلِيلًا
en: Do you not see how your Lord extends the shade? If He had willed, He could have made it still. Then We made the sun an indication of it[24].
u.src: 25:45  Do you not see how your Lord extends the shade? If He had willed, He could have made it still. Then We made the sun an indication of it[24].

en: [24] i.e., indication for its existence or making it apparent.

p.src: 25:46  Then We gradually draw it towards Us [i.e., Then the sun climbs up]?

ar: ثُمَّ قَبَضْنَـٰهُ إِلَيْنَا قَبْضًا يَسِيرًا
en: Then We gradually draw it towards Us [i.e., Then the sun climbs up]?
u.src: 25:46  Then We gradually draw it towards Us [i.e., Then the sun climbs up]?

p.src: 25:47  It is He Who has made the night as a garment[25] for you, and made sleep for rest; and has made daytime for returning to life[26].

ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ لِبَاسًا وَٱلنَّوْمَ سُبَاتًا وَجَعَلَ ٱلنَّهَارَ نُشُورًا
en: It is He Who has made the night as a garment[25] for you, and made sleep for rest; and has made daytime for returning to life[26].
u.src: 25:47  It is He Who has made the night as a garment[25] for you, and made sleep for rest; and has made daytime for returning to life[26].

en:
[25] It covers you in darkness and provides rest.
 [26] To return to your livelihood and activity.

p.src: 25:48  It is He Who sends the winds as harbingers before His mercy, and We send down from the sky pure water,

ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ ٱلرِّيَـٰحَ بُشْرًۢا بَيْنَ يَدَىْ رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً طَهُورًا
en: It is He Who sends the winds as harbingers before His mercy, and We send down from the sky pure water,
u.src: 25:48  It is He Who sends the winds as harbingers before His mercy, and We send down from the sky pure water,

p.src: 25:49  so that We may revive therewith a dead land, and quench the thirst of countless beasts and humans We have created.

ar: لِّنُحْـِۧىَ بِهِۦ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا وَنُسْقِيَهُۥ مِمَّا خَلَقْنَآ أَنْعَـٰمًا وَأَنَاسِىَّ كَثِيرًا
en: so that We may revive therewith a dead land, and quench the thirst of countless beasts and humans We have created.
u.src: 25:49  so that We may revive therewith a dead land, and quench the thirst of countless beasts and humans We have created.

p.src: 25:50  We distribute it among them so that they may take heed[27], but most people persist in their ingratitude.

ar: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَـٰهُ بَيْنَهُمْ لِيَذَّكَّرُوا۟ فَأَبَىٰٓ أَكْثَرُ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورًا
en: We distribute it among them so that they may take heed[27], but most people persist in their ingratitude.
u.src: 25:50  We distribute it among them so that they may take heed[27], but most people persist in their ingratitude.

en: [27] Such as Allah’s ability to bring the dead to life.

p.src: 25:51  If We had willed, We could have sent to each town a warner[28].

ar: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَبَعَثْنَا فِى كُلِّ قَرْيَةٍ نَّذِيرًا
en: If We had willed, We could have sent to each town a warner[28].
u.src: 25:51  If We had willed, We could have sent to each town a warner[28].

en: [28] But instead, Allah sent Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) as the final messenger for all people.

p.src: 25:52  So do not obey the disbelievers, but strive against them with this [Qur’an] a great striving.

ar: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ وَجَـٰهِدْهُم بِهِۦ جِهَادًا كَبِيرًا
en: So do not obey the disbelievers, but strive against them with this [Qur’an] a great striving.
u.src: 25:52  So do not obey the disbelievers, but strive against them with this [Qur’an] a great striving.

p.src: 25:53  It is He Who merges the two bodies of water: one fresh and palatable and the other salty and bitter, and He has made between them a barrier and an insurmountable partition[29].

ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ هَـٰذَا عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ وَهَـٰذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخًا وَحِجْرًا مَّحْجُورًا
en: It is He Who merges the two bodies of water: one fresh and palatable and the other salty and bitter, and He has made between them a barrier and an insurmountable partition[29].
u.src: 25:53  It is He Who merges the two bodies of water: one fresh and palatable and the other salty and bitter, and He has made between them a barrier and an insurmountable partition[29].

en: [29] When salt and fresh waters meet, although both mix together, each still keeps its distinctive qualities, as if a barrier prevents them from mixing completely.

p.src: 25:54  It is He Who created human beings from water[30], then made between them bonds of kinship and marriage, for your Lord is Most Capable.

ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ بَشَرًا فَجَعَلَهُۥ نَسَبًا وَصِهْرًا ۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ قَدِيرًا
en: It is He Who created human beings from water[30], then made between them bonds of kinship and marriage, for your Lord is Most Capable.
ja: 婚戚関係（からなるもの）
u.src: 25:54  It is He Who created human beings from water[30], then made between them bonds of kinship and marriage, for your Lord is Most Capable.

en: [30] i.e., the zygote (the mixture of sperm and egg).

p.src: 25:55  Yet they worship besides Allah that which can neither benefit nor harm them; the disbeliever always collaborates against his Lord[31].

ar: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُهُمْ وَلَا يَضُرُّهُمْ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱلْكَافِرُ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ ظَهِيرًا
en: Yet they worship besides Allah that which can neither benefit nor harm them; the disbeliever always collaborates against his Lord[31].
u.src: 25:55  Yet they worship besides Allah that which can neither benefit nor harm them; the disbeliever always collaborates against his Lord[31].

en: [31] i.e., helping and defending those who rebel against Allah.

p.src: 25:56  We have not sent you [O Prophet] except as a bearer of glad tidings and a warner.

ar: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا
en: We have not sent you [O Prophet] except as a bearer of glad tidings and a warner.
u.src: 25:56  We have not sent you [O Prophet] except as a bearer of glad tidings and a warner.

p.src: 25:57  Say, “I do not ask you for any reward for it, except that anyone who wishes to take a path to his Lord[32].”

ar: قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ أَن يَتَّخِذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
en: Say, “I do not ask you for any reward for it, except that anyone who wishes to take a path to his Lord[32].”
u.src: 25:57  Say, “I do not ask you for any reward for it, except that anyone who wishes to take a path to his Lord[32].”

en: [32] By spending in the way of Allah.

p.src: 25:58  Put your trust in the Ever-Living Who never dies, and glorify Him with praise. He is Sufficient as All-Aware of the sins of His slaves –

ar: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْحَىِّ ٱلَّذِى لَا يَمُوتُ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِهِۦ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِهِۦ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًا
en: Put your trust in the Ever-Living Who never dies, and glorify Him with praise. He is Sufficient as All-Aware of the sins of His slaves –
u.src: 25:58  Put your trust in the Ever-Living Who never dies, and glorify Him with praise. He is Sufficient as All-Aware of the sins of His slaves –

p.src: 25:59  it is He Who created the heavens and earth and all that is between them in six Days[33], then rose over the Throne[34]. He is the Most Compassionate, so ask about Him the One Who is All-Aware.

ar: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ۚ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ فَسْـَٔلْ بِهِۦ خَبِيرًا
en: it is He Who created the heavens and earth and all that is between them in six Days[33], then rose over the Throne[34]. He is the Most Compassionate, so ask about Him the One Who is All-Aware.
u.src: 25:59  it is He Who created the heavens and earth and all that is between them in six Days[33], then rose over the Throne[34]. He is the Most Compassionate, so ask about Him the One Who is All-Aware.

en:
[33] The "six Days" does not necessarily mean six 24 hours of time; for a heavenly Day is 1,000 years of our time. (see 22:47), whereas the Day of Judgment will be 50,000 years of our time (see 70:4). Hence, its duration is only known to Allah.
 [34] See footnote 7:54.

p.src: 25:60  When it is said to them, “Prostrate to the Most Compassionate,” they say, “What is ‘the Most Compassionate?’ Shall we prostrate to what you order us?” And it only increases their aversion.

ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ قَالُوا۟ وَمَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ أَنَسْجُدُ لِمَا تَأْمُرُنَا وَزَادَهُمْ نُفُورًا ۩
en: When it is said to them, “Prostrate to the Most Compassionate,” they say, “What is ‘the Most Compassionate?’ Shall we prostrate to what you order us?” And it only increases their aversion.
u.src: 25:60  When it is said to them, “Prostrate to the Most Compassionate,” they say, “What is ‘the Most Compassionate?’ Shall we prostrate to what you order us?” And it only increases their aversion.

p.src: 25:61  Blessed is He Who placed in the sky constellations and placed therein a radiant lamp[35] and a luminous moon.

ar: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًا وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا سِرَٰجًا وَقَمَرًا مُّنِيرًا
en: Blessed is He Who placed in the sky constellations and placed therein a radiant lamp[35] and a luminous moon.
u.src: 25:61  Blessed is He Who placed in the sky constellations and placed therein a radiant lamp[35] and a luminous moon.

en: [35] i.e., the sun.

p.src: 25:62  It is He Who made the night and the day to follow each other so that everyone who wishes may reflect or become grateful.

ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ خِلْفَةً لِّمَنْ أَرَادَ أَن يَذَّكَّرَ أَوْ أَرَادَ شُكُورًا
en: It is He Who made the night and the day to follow each other so that everyone who wishes may reflect or become grateful.
u.src: 25:62  It is He Who made the night and the day to follow each other so that everyone who wishes may reflect or become grateful.

p.src: 25:63  The slaves of the Most Compassionate are those who walk on earth humbly[36], and when the ignorant address them, they only say words of peace[37];

ar: وَعِبَادُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ هَوْنًا وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ ٱلْجَـٰهِلُونَ قَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا
en: The slaves of the Most Compassionate are those who walk on earth humbly[36], and when the ignorant address them, they only say words of peace[37];
u.src: 25:63  The slaves of the Most Compassionate are those who walk on earth humbly[36], and when the ignorant address them, they only say words of peace[37];

en: [36] i.e., without arrogance, but with dignity. [37] i.e., words free from evil.

p.src: 25:64  and those who spend the night prostrating and standing before their Lord;

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَبِيتُونَ لِرَبِّهِمْ سُجَّدًا وَقِيَـٰمًا
en: and those who spend the night prostrating and standing before their Lord;
u.src: 25:64  and those who spend the night prostrating and standing before their Lord;

p.src: 25:65  and those who say, “Our Lord, turn the punishment of Hell away from us, for its punishment is unrelenting[38].”

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا ٱصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا
en: and those who say, “Our Lord, turn the punishment of Hell away from us, for its punishment is unrelenting[38].”
u.src: 25:65  and those who say, “Our Lord, turn the punishment of Hell away from us, for its punishment is unrelenting[38].”

en: [38] i.e., ever adhering.

p.src: 25:66  It is an evil place to settle and an evil abode.”

ar: إِنَّهَا سَآءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا
en: It is an evil place to settle and an evil abode.”
u.src: 25:66  It is an evil place to settle and an evil abode.”

p.src: 25:67  And those who neither spend wastefully nor stingily, but are moderate between them;

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَنفَقُوا۟ لَمْ يُسْرِفُوا۟ وَلَمْ يَقْتُرُوا۟ وَكَانَ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ قَوَامًا
en: And those who neither spend wastefully nor stingily, but are moderate between them;
u.src: 25:67  And those who neither spend wastefully nor stingily, but are moderate between them;

p.src: 25:68  and those who do not invoke besides Allah another god, and who do not kill a soul whom Allah has forbidden, except in the course of justice, and who do not commit adultery, for whoever does any of this will face the penalty,

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَدْعُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ وَلَا يَقْتُلُونَ ٱلنَّفْسَ ٱلَّتِى حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا يَزْنُونَ ۚ وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ يَلْقَ أَثَامًا
en: and those who do not invoke besides Allah another god, and who do not kill a soul whom Allah has forbidden, except in the course of justice, and who do not commit adultery, for whoever does any of this will face the penalty,
u.src: 25:68  and those who do not invoke besides Allah another god, and who do not kill a soul whom Allah has forbidden, except in the course of justice, and who do not commit adultery, for whoever does any of this will face the penalty,

p.src: 25:69  the punishment will be doubled for him on the Day of Resurrection, wherein he will remain disgraced forever,

ar: يُضَـٰعَفْ لَهُ ٱلْعَذَابُ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ وَيَخْلُدْ فِيهِۦ مُهَانًا
en: the punishment will be doubled for him on the Day of Resurrection, wherein he will remain disgraced forever,
u.src: 25:69  the punishment will be doubled for him on the Day of Resurrection, wherein he will remain disgraced forever,

p.src: 25:70  except those who repent and believe, and do righteous deeds; for them Allah will change their evil deeds into good deeds, for Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

ar: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلًا صَـٰلِحًا فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ حَسَنَـٰتٍ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
en: except those who repent and believe, and do righteous deeds; for them Allah will change their evil deeds into good deeds, for Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
u.src: 25:70  except those who repent and believe, and do righteous deeds; for them Allah will change their evil deeds into good deeds, for Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

p.src: 25:71  Whoever repents and does righteous deeds has turned to Allah with sincere repentance.

ar: وَمَن تَابَ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا فَإِنَّهُۥ يَتُوبُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَتَابًا
en: Whoever repents and does righteous deeds has turned to Allah with sincere repentance.
u.src: 25:71  Whoever repents and does righteous deeds has turned to Allah with sincere repentance.

p.src: 25:72  And those who do not witness falsehood[39], and when they pass by futility, they pass by with dignity;

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَشْهَدُونَ ٱلزُّورَ وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِٱللَّغْوِ مَرُّوا۟ كِرَامًا
en: And those who do not witness falsehood[39], and when they pass by futility, they pass by with dignity;
u.src: 25:72  And those who do not witness falsehood[39], and when they pass by futility, they pass by with dignity;

en: [39] i.e., places of sin, evil, and indecency.

p.src: 25:73  and those who, when they are reminded of the verses of their Lord, they do not turn a deaf ear or a blind eye to them;

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَمْ يَخِرُّوا۟ عَلَيْهَا صُمًّا وَعُمْيَانًا
en: and those who, when they are reminded of the verses of their Lord, they do not turn a deaf ear or a blind eye to them;
u.src: 25:73  and those who, when they are reminded of the verses of their Lord, they do not turn a deaf ear or a blind eye to them;

p.src: 25:74  and those who say, “Our Lord, let our spouses and children be a source of joy for us[40], and make us good examples for the righteous.”

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّـٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَٱجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
en: and those who say, “Our Lord, let our spouses and children be a source of joy for us[40], and make us good examples for the righteous.”
u.src: 25:74  and those who say, “Our Lord, let our spouses and children be a source of joy for us[40], and make us good examples for the righteous.”

en: [40] i.e., a source of happiness for their righteousness and adhering to a straight path.

p.src: 25:75  It is they who will be rewarded with high palaces [in Paradise] for their perseverance, and they will be received therein with salutations and greetings of peace,

ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يُجْزَوْنَ ٱلْغُرْفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ وَيُلَقَّوْنَ فِيهَا تَحِيَّةً وَسَلَـٰمًا
en: It is they who will be rewarded with high palaces [in Paradise] for their perseverance, and they will be received therein with salutations and greetings of peace,
u.src: 25:75  It is they who will be rewarded with high palaces [in Paradise] for their perseverance, and they will be received therein with salutations and greetings of peace,

p.src: 25:76  abiding therein forever. What an excellent abode and a resting place!

ar: خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ حَسُنَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا
en: abiding therein forever. What an excellent abode and a resting place!
u.src: 25:76  abiding therein forever. What an excellent abode and a resting place!

p.src: 25:77  Say [O Prophet], “My Lord would not care at all about you, were it not for your supplication[41]. Now since you have rejected [the truth], the inevitable is bound to come[42].”

ar: قُلْ مَا يَعْبَؤُا۟ بِكُمْ رَبِّى لَوْلَا دُعَآؤُكُمْ ۖ فَقَدْ كَذَّبْتُمْ فَسَوْفَ يَكُونُ لِزَامًۢا
en: Say [O Prophet], “My Lord would not care at all about you, were it not for your supplication[41]. Now since you have rejected [the truth], the inevitable is bound to come[42].”
u.src: 25:77  Say [O Prophet], “My Lord would not care at all about you, were it not for your supplication[41]. Now since you have rejected [the truth], the inevitable is bound to come[42].”

en:
[41] i.e., faith and worship.
 [42] Or it will be adhering to you.
